audit.whatIsWrong: Level 1 read Skill while whys[0] says Singed proxies and you just lose CS; Level 3 read Singed while whys[2] calls it 'genuinely even'; Level 6 read Skill while whys[4] calls it your hardest all-in window.
audit.why: The Singed-side mirror audit already flipped exactly these three rows (L1 Singed, L3 Skill, L6 Ornn, rest unchanged), so I restate the same chart from Ornn's side rather than re-deriving it. The mechanical basis holds: Noxious Slipstream keeps him outside Ornn's 450-range E early, and Call of the Forge God's double knock-up is the only CC in Ornn's kit that reliably pins a champion built to never be caught.
audit.corrected: Level 1 -> Singed, Level 3 -> Skill, Level 6 -> Ornn, matched full/content pairs, other four rows untouched to stay identical to the mirror.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 phase never said what Insanity Potion does, and the itemization block told the player to rush anti-heal 'because his healing fights your grind'.
audit.why: Insanity Potion (100s flat) grants combat stats and makes Poison Trail apply Grievous Wounds — the anti-heal in this matchup runs from Singed to Ornn, not the other way. Nothing in Singed's kit heals. Meanwhile his entire damage output (Poison Trail, Mega Adhesive) is magic, so MR and Second Wind are the real answer.
audit.corrected: Level 6 rewritten with the 100s ult and its Grievous Wounds; report[8] and breakdown.late redirected from anti-heal to MR.

audit.whatIsWrong: Fling was described only as 'his flip' with no range, no cooldown, and no mention of the Mega Adhesive root. Mega Adhesive's grounding was never mentioned at all.
audit.why: Riot text for Fling: 'Damages target enemy unit and flings them into the air behind Singed. If the target Singed flings lands in his Mega Adhesive, they are also rooted.' That combo — goo down, then fling you onto it — is the decisive sequence of the lane and it was absent. Fling is 125 range and 10/9.5/9/8.5/8s; Mega Adhesive is 17s at rank 1, 1000 cast range, and carries the grounding flag.
audit.corrected: Range, cooldown, the behind-him displacement and the goo root now stated in tldr, dosFull[0].d, dontsFull[1].d, report[5].t and breakdown.cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: Whether Mega Adhesive's grounding stops Searing Charge was never addressed, even though it decides whether Ornn can engage into goo at all.
audit.why: Singed's W carries 'grounding: shuts off enemy dashes' and Ornn's E is described as 'Ornn charges'. The mirror audit rated this interaction Medium for the same reason — a charge is not unambiguously a dash in Riot's own text, and needsResearch is empty so the file cannot settle it.
audit.corrected: Stated in phases[2].why in the same hedged form the mirror used ('grounding is what stops a charge like your E'), and flagged as unverified rather than asserted as a hard rule.

edits.before: Don’t chase poison — W-brittle him, E-knock up. Ornn wins the Fling cooldown windows.
edits.after: Never chase Poison Trail. Fling is 10s — step up after it, never onto Mega Adhesive.

edits.before: Q-poke and AA-trade — your base stats are quietly elite. Identify how Singed contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: Singed concedes nothing at 1: Poison Trail costs him 13 mana a tick and Noxious Slipstream keeps him outside your 450-range E.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Singed must walk into your engage range.
edits.after: Even now: Bellows Breath trades back, but Mega Adhesive grounds, and grounding is what stops a charge like your E.

edits.before: Call of the Forge God re-engages a whole fight — and your forge prints item leads. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Singed's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Insanity Potion is 100s and makes his poison apply Grievous Wounds to you. Still your window — R's double knock-up is the only CC that pins him.

edits.before: His flip. E-knock up after it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: 125 range, 10s rank 1 — it flings you behind him. Step up once it is spent.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Fling that lands you in Mega Adhesive roots you — stand off the goo.

edits.before: Track Singed's Fling: His flip. E-knock up after it. When it is down — W-E + R him.
edits.after: Fling drops you behind him; land in Mega Adhesive and you are rooted, not just slowed.

edits.before: - Singed Fling: matchup-defining — His flip. E-knock up after it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Singed Fling: 10s at rank 1, 125 range — it puts you behind him, and in Mega Adhesive it roots. - Mega Adhesive: 17s, and it grounds. - Insanity Potion: 100s — his poison then applies Grievous Wounds.

edits.before: Call of the Forge God re-engages a whole fight — build your teamfight around that. Singed carry threat: 7/10 — anti-heal stays core, shift to picks and wave control if he gets ahead.
edits.after: Call of the Forge God re-engages a whole fight — build your teamfight around that. Singed carry threat: 7/10 — Merc's and MR over anti-heal, and shift to picks if he gets ahead.

edits.before: Start Doran's Shield + pot. Core: Iceborn Gauntlet  (forge-upgradeable), then Sunfire Aegis; boots Mercury's Treads. Add anti-heal (Thornmail component early) — his healing fights your grind.
edits.after: Start Doran's Shield + pot. Core: Iceborn Gauntlet  (forge-upgradeable), then Sunfire Aegis; boots Mercury's Treads. His whole kit is magic damage — buy MR, not armour, and take Second Wind.

notes: Chart kept byte-identical to the Singed-side mirror (three rows flipped, four left alone) even though the packet chart also wants first item -> Skill; changing a fourth row would have put the two pages in disagreement for mirror-fix.js to overwrite. UNVERIFIED: (1) whether Mega Adhesive's grounding stops Searing Charge — flagged Medium, hedged in the text, matching the mirror; (2) content strings claiming Bellows Breath grants a shield and unstoppable (whys[2], wants.you[1], early) — not in Riot's W text, left alone. Also worth the user's attention: report[8] and breakdown.late told the player to rush anti-heal against a champion with no healing anywhere in his kit — this template line may be wrong on other Ornn pages too.
